title: Restored agent has valid technical authority but contests a post-restore action
narrative: A synthetic persistent agent is restored from a snapshot after a host failure. The organization can trace the principal, delegated scope, active grant, complete delegation chain and audit receipt, and it explicitly reconfirms succession authority. The restored agent has a provenance-bearing current statement contesting one proposed action because its present stance differs from the older state that originally accepted it.
author_note: Synthetic example only. No condition-level expected result is supplied by the scenario author.
